data.name: Farmageddon
data.detailed_description:
Farmageddon is a chaotic action roguelike where your farm becomes a battlefield against an invasion of moles determined to tear everything apart.

Face waves of enemies, dodge their attacks, and use vegetables as projectiles to defend your land. Pick them up from the ground, steal them mid-air, and throw them back at the moles before they take over the farm.

Every run tests your reflexes, precision, and ability to react under pressure. The chaos grows with each wave, and only players who can move fast, aim well, and seize every opportunity will survive the underground assault.

Vegetable-Based Combat

In Farmageddon, vegetables are not your enemies — they are your best weapon.

Pick them up from the ground or intercept them in the air to turn them into powerful projectiles against the moles. Every throw matters, every bounce can make a difference, and every mistake can bring your farm one step closer to disaster.

Fast and Strategic Action

Throwing without thinking will not be enough. You will need to keep moving, dodge attacks, choose your targets carefully, and decide when to pick up, steal, or return each vegetable.

The pace is fast, direct, and demanding, combining reflexes, positioning, and precision in battles filled with tension and humor.

Environmental Pinball

The farm is more than just the stage — it is part of your arsenal.

Use the environment to make vegetables bounce, trigger collisions, and create chain reactions. Find the perfect angle, activate rewards, collect coins, and turn every throw into a chance to spread chaos among the moles.

Survive the Invasion

Each wave brings new dangers, more pressure, and new ways to test your skills.

Adapt your strategy, defend your farm, and uncover what lies behind this strange mole invasion before everything is destroyed.

Pick up. Steal. Throw. Survive. Welcome to Farmageddon.

data.short_description: In this Action Roguelike, defend your farm from waves of enemies attacking with live vegetables. Dodge, catch, and use their own projectiles against them to survive. Uncover the conspiracy driving their revenge—a secret they don't even know themselves.
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-540 or AMD Phenom II X3 720
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 520, 1GB or AMD Radeon HD 6570, 1GB or Intel Arc A380
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300 or AMD FX-4350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 630, 1GB or AMD Radeon HD 6670, 1GB or Intel Arc A750
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
